instruction: Create a new directory called "my-website" for your project.
Move into your newly created "my-website" project directory.
Create your main webpage file named "index.html".
List the files in the directory to verify both files were created.
Clear the terminal screen to declutter your workspace before initializing Git.
Turn this directory into a Git repository by initializing it.
Check the repository status to see which files are untracked.
Move all files to the Staging Area so they are ready to be saved.
Save this state to your Git history with the message "Initial commit".
View your commit history to verify your first snapshot was saved.
